claims.statement: A slot is the server-side representation of a session waiting for peers to join, with lifecycle states WAITING, ACTIVE, FULL, and CLOSED.
The PAKE handshake establishes a shared secret used to HMAC-sign SDP messages for authentication and to derive keys for DTLS 1.3 encryption of the WebRTC data channel.

The chat feature exchanges messages over the WebRTC data channel using a symmetric protocol with TagMessage, TagChatClose, TagParticipantLeave, and TagCancelled tags, managed by the chat.Session type.

The schedule feature enables delayed file transfers with client-side AES-256-GCM encryption, storing encrypted chunks on the server until decryption via a shareable URL containing the file ID and key fragment.
Crypto constraints include DTLS 1.3 for WebRTC encryption, HKDF for key derivation from the PAKE secret, HMAC with SHA-256 for SDP signing, and AES-256-GCM for schedule uploads.
